caption: The drawing depicts a single large, tan-colored jug positioned upright in the center of the composition, with a rounded body, a narrow neck, and a handle attached near the top. The jug’s surface displays darker spots and light shading, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. On the upper left section of the drawing, there is a separate rectangular inset showing a black line illustration of an eagle with outstretched wings perched atop a shield, clutching foliage in its talons. Above the eagle, the text “D. GOODALE. HARTFORD” is written in capital letters. The jug itself also features a partially visible version of the same eagle illustration near the top, next to the handle. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color, and there is a faint rectangular border around the central jug. The artist’s signature, “Chas. C. Gasan,” is written in small letters in the lower right corner.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
